payload.lua_script:
local tl = Session:new_audio_track(1, 2, ARDOUR.RouteGroup(), 1, "A7_SINE_EXPORT_RUN77", -1, ARDOUR.TrackMode.Normal, true)
assert(not tl:empty(), "failed to create export track")
local r = tl:front()
assert(not r:isnil(), "export route nil")
local p = ARDOUR.LuaAPI.new_luaproc(Session, "SinGen")
assert(not p:isnil(), "SinGen unavailable")
r:add_processor_by_index(p, 0, nil, true)
assert(ARDOUR.LuaAPI.set_processor_param(p, 0, 440), "failed frequency")
assert(ARDOUR.LuaAPI.set_processor_param(p, 1, -12), "failed gain")
Session:set_session_range_is_free(false)
Session:set_session_extents(Temporal.timepos_t(0), Temporal.timepos_t(96000))
print("A7_SINGEN_ROUTE=" .. r:name())
print("A7_SESSION_END=" .. tostring(Session:current_end_sample()))
